name: rasa.module.crew.member
description: RasaOS Module · Crew Member: the member tier of a galt crew (galt ADR 0042, 0050, 0052): member cards, each a role a lead hires (scout, auditor, builder, tester, reviewer and the rest), plus the engineering standard every writer builds to.

rasa.family: rasa.module.crew (the crew role registry); manager → lead → member
rasa.note: Snapshot of galt's built-in crew cards: galt still reads its in-code copies until it reads this Element (galt ADR 0064 Consequences: the base members move into Elements, roles.ts stays as the fallback).

element.description: Element-owned card files mirrored into the install target's .claude/crew/.

files.note: The cards. galt finds .claude/crew/leads and .claude/crew/members as a repo's brain layer (crew/card-header.ts CARD_DIRS).
